note: BANG fired at one medium AK at 2332 I from 2350 yds and saw it disappear; a ship was sunk at 2337 I 3.5 nm away (J03) and Hozan Maru was seen torpedoed at 2339 I (J02). The US Navy chronology gives Hozan Maru to REDFISH; REDFISH's report would settle it

japanese.original: 敵潜水艦ノ攻撃ヲ受ケ沈没セル船舶アリ N24°21′ E122°38′ 二二日二三三七
japanese.translation: A ship has been sunk by enemy submarine attack, N 24°21′ E 122°38′, 22nd 2337

note: Of TAKA-206's six ships, three were sunk (Hozan, Amakusa, Sakae Maru) and three reached Funauki (J04). BANG claimed four sunk and one damaged in seven attacks; the postwar credit is two (Sakae, Amakusa)

japanese.ship: Hozan Maru; Amakusa Maru; Sakae Maru
japanese.translation: At 2339 the second ship in the column, Hozan Maru, is torpedoed, as are Amakusa Maru and Sakae Maru; all three are sunk
